snippet.title: Under Par Golf Architect - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
THE COURSE IS OPEN. THE CLUB IS YOURS. ⛳🏗️

Under Par Golf Architect is officially available! 

Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

GET IT NOW:

Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/2928410/Under_Par_Golf_Architect
Epic Games Store: http://store.epicgames.com/p/underpar-f66e91
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10013324
Xbox Series S|X: http://microsoft.com/store/productid/9p8lwtv8263x
Nintendo Switch 2: http://nintendo.com/us/store/products/under-par-golf-architect-switch-2
